outcome: Glycemic control (percentage of time in range)
cohort: The study included 112 randomly selected patients with Type 1 Diabetes from Gran Canaria, with a median age of 12 years (51.8% female).
finding: Insulin pump use, adherence to the Mediterranean diet, and age were independently associated with better glycemic control, while years with Type 1 Diabetes was associated with worse HbA1c values.
